title: Corpus manifest
description: Per-node corpus manifest (D10). Lives at <node>/corpus/manifest.yaml and is the source of truth for the reference documents a node contributes to branch-scoped RAG. Filtering never applies to reference context: it accumulates up the tree (union of every ancestor's corpus).

entries.description: The reference documents in this node's corpus/ directory.

file.description: Filename relative to this node's corpus/ directory. Kebab-case, must include an extension. Studio uploads additionally restrict the extension to: text (md, txt, csv, json, yaml, yml, xml, html), pdf, images (png, jpg, jpeg, gif, svg, webp), and office docs (docx, xlsx, pptx); this pattern itself allows any lowercase extension so pre-existing manifests keep validating.

source.description: Provenance: citation, origin, or description. Never an internal URL or secret.

license.description: License or usage terms of the source material (e.g. CC-BY-4.0, public-domain, internal).
